palettes.name: Studio Cyan
palettes.why: Recommended. The backlight's own cyan as the one accent, on near-black. Clean, modern, and matches the set exactly.

palettes.name: Cyan + Amber
palettes.why: Teal/orange contrast from both of the set's lights: cyan for keywords, amber for numbers and highlights. Warmer, more energetic.

palettes.name: Deep Blue Editorial
palettes.why: A calmer, deeper blue with soft cream. Premium editorial feel for serif keywords.
